title.gu: યુનિટ 5 Notes — Compression Member (Strut) નું Design

items.syllabus_item: 5.1 strut effective length slenderness radius gyration

body.en:
A strut is a member predominantly under axial compression, such as a truss web. Failure may involve overall flexural buckling, local buckling or yielding; slender members generally buckle before gross yield. This unit treats struts, not complete column design. The ideal elastic pinned-pinned buckling load is π²EI/L², but real design includes imperfections, yielding, residual stresses and actual end conditions.

Effective length KL reflects restraint and frame stability; common idealized values include K = 1 for pinned-pinned and K = 2 for a fixed-free cantilever, but actual restraints and code provisions control. Radius of gyration r = √(I/A); check relevant axes and the largest slenderness KL/r. For unequal angles use actual principal-axis properties. IS 800 limits slenderness based on member function; determine the applicable case rather than applying one limit universally.
body.gu:
Strut એ મુખ્યત્વે axial compression ધરાવતો member છે, જેમ કે truss web. Failure માં overall flexural buckling, local buckling અથવા yielding હોઈ શકે; slender members સામાન્ય રીતે gross yield પહેલાં buckle થાય છે. આ unit માં struts છે, સંપૂર્ણ column design નથી. Ideal elastic pinned-pinned buckling load π²EI/L² છે, પરંતુ વાસ્તવિક design માં imperfections, yielding, residual stresses અને end conditions ગણવામાં આવે છે.

Effective length KL restraint અને frame stability દર્શાવે છે; સામાન્ય idealized values pinned-pinned માટે K = 1 અને fixed-free cantilever માટે K = 2 છે, પણ actual restraints અને code provisions નિયંત્રિત કરે છે. Radius of gyration r = √(I/A); સંબંધિત axes અને સૌથી વધુ slenderness KL/r તપાસો. Unequal angles માટે actual principal-axis properties લો. IS 800 માં member function પ્રમાણે slenderness limits છે; એક જ limit બધે ન લગાવો.

body.en:
Classify plate elements using width-to-thickness ratios and the applicable IS 800:2007 Table 2 limits; section class affects which strength provisions can be used. Steel design compressive stress fcd depends on yield stress, elastic modulus, equivalent slenderness, buckling class and imperfection factor α. Select buckling class from the correct IS 800 section, fabrication, axis and code table; α values a, b, c and d are 0.21, 0.34, 0.49 and 0.76 respectively. Do not assume that every angle or axis has the same class.

For a qualifying concentrically loaded member, nondimensional slenderness λ̄ = (KL/r)√(fy/(π²E)); φ = 0.5[1 + α(λ̄ − 0.2) + λ̄²]; χ = 1/[φ + √(φ² − λ̄²)], limited as required by the code. Then fcd = χ fy/γm0 and Pd = Ae fcd. Use appropriate effective area Ae for the applicable section class and code checks. The tabulated stress may instead be obtained by interpolation as permitted.
body.gu:
Plate elements ને width-to-thickness ratios અને લાગુ IS 800:2007 Table 2 limits પરથી classify કરો; section class થી strength provisions નક્કી થાય છે. Steel design compressive stress fcd, yield stress, elastic modulus, equivalent slenderness, buckling class અને imperfection factor α પર આધારિત છે. યોગ્ય IS 800 table માં section, fabrication અને axis પ્રમાણે buckling class પસંદ કરો; a, b, c અને d માટે α અનુક્રમે 0.21, 0.34, 0.49 અને 0.76 છે. દરેક angle અથવા axis માટે એક જ class માની ન લો.

લાગુ concentrically loaded member માટે nondimensional slenderness λ̄ = (KL/r)√(fy/(π²E)); φ = 0.5[1 + α(λ̄ − 0.2) + λ̄²]; χ = 1/[φ + √(φ² − λ̄²)] છે, code મુજબ મર્યાદિત રાખો. પછી fcd = χ fy/γm0 અને Pd = Ae fcd. લાગુ section class અને code checks માટે યોગ્ય effective area Ae લો. મંજૂર હોય તો tabulated stress interpolation વડે પણ મેળવી શકાય.

body.en:
A single angle connected by one leg can be eccentrically loaded and has special equivalent-slenderness provisions in IS 800:2007 clause 7.5.1.2 and Table 12. Their use depends on connection and end-restraint conditions: verify applicability, bolt/weld arrangement, section properties and relevant axes. Do not simply use KL/r for a one-leg-connected angle unless the specific conditions and alternative method justify it. Examine member eccentricity and connection strength.

For double angles, specify their orientation relative to the gusset, load transfer, effective length and whether the angles are connected together. Apply IS 800 built-up member and connection requirements where applicable, including spacing and individual component slenderness. Gross-area multiplication alone does not establish safe capacity. Obtain actual section properties from verified steel tables.
body.gu:
એક leg થી જોડાયેલ single angle પર eccentric load હોઈ શકે છે અને IS 800:2007 clause 7.5.1.2 તથા Table 12 માં special equivalent-slenderness provisions છે. તેનો ઉપયોગ connection અને end-restraint conditions પર આધારિત છે: applicability, bolt/weld arrangement, section properties અને સંબંધિત axes તપાસો. ચોક્કસ conditions અને alternative method યોગ્ય ન હોય તો one-leg-connected angle માટે ફક્ત KL/r ન વાપરો. Member eccentricity અને connection strength તપાસો.

Double angles માટે gusset ની સામે orientation, load transfer, effective length અને angles એકબીજા સાથે જોડાયેલા છે કે નહીં જણાવો. લાગુ હોય ત્યાં spacing અને individual component slenderness સહિત IS 800 built-up member અને connection requirements અનુસરો. ફક્ત gross-area multiplication થી safe capacity સાબિત થતી નથી. Actual section properties verified steel tables માંથી લો.

body.en: 1. Determine factored compression and member length from structural analysis. 2. Select trial section, grade, orientation and connection. 3. Check section classification and calculate effective lengths and slenderness using the proper general or special angle rule. 4. Select buckling class and determine fcd. 5. Calculate Pd and compare with factored compression. 6. Check slenderness limit, local buckling, connectors, gussets and eccentricity; revise as necessary. Complete design needs actual code clauses, dimensions and restraint information.
body.gu: 1. Structural analysis થી factored compression અને member length લો. 2. Trial section, grade, orientation અને connection પસંદ કરો. 3. Section classification તપાસી યોગ્ય general અથવા special angle rule થી effective lengths અને slenderness ગણો. 4. Buckling class પસંદ કરી fcd મેળવો. 5. Pd ગણી factored compression સાથે સરખાવો. 6. Slenderness limit, local buckling, connectors, gussets અને eccentricity તપાસી જરૂરી સુધારો કરો. સંપૂર્ણ design માટે actual code clauses, dimensions અને restraint માહિતી જરૂરી છે.

title.en: Numerical 5.1 — Radius of gyration and slenderness
title.gu: Numerical 5.1 — Radius of gyration અને slenderness

body.en:
Given: A concentrically loaded strut has area 1200 mm², minor-axis I = 480000 mm⁴, length 2000 mm and K = 1. Find r and KL/r about this axis.

Step 1. Calculate radius of gyration.

r = √(I / A)r = √(480000 / 1200)r = 20 mm

Step 2. Calculate effective length and slenderness.

KL = 1 × 2000KL = 2000 mmKL / r = 2000 / 20

Final answer:

Slenderness about the given axis = 100; check other axes and the applicable code limit.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Concentrically loaded strut માટે area 1200 mm², minor-axis I = 480000 mm⁴, length 2000 mm અને K = 1 છે. આ axis માટે r અને KL/r શોધો.

Step 1. Radius of gyration ગણો.

r = √(I / A)r = √(480000 / 1200)r = 20 mm

Step 2. Effective length અને slenderness ગણો.

KL = 1 × 2000KL = 2000 mmKL / r = 2000 / 20

અંતિમ જવાબ:

આપેલ axis પર slenderness = 100; અન્ય axes તથા લાગુ code limit તપાસો.

title.en: Numerical 5.2 — Compressive strength using buckling curve
title.gu: Numerical 5.2 — Buckling curve વડે compressive strength

body.en:
Given: For a qualifying centrally loaded non-slender strut assume governing KL/r = 100, A = 1200 mm², fy = 250 MPa, E = 200000 MPa, γm0 = 1.10 and buckling class c (α = 0.49). Find design strength. This is not a one-leg-connected angle calculation.

Step 1. Find nondimensional slenderness.

λ̄ = (KL / r) √(fy / (π²E))λ̄ = 100 √(250 / (π² × 200000))λ̄ ≈ 1.1254

Step 2. Calculate the buckling parameters.

φ = 0.5[1 + α(λ̄ − 0.2) + λ̄²]φ = 0.5[1 + 0.49(1.1254 − 0.2) + 1.1254²]φ ≈ 1.3600χ = 1 / [φ + √(φ² − λ̄²)]χ ≈ 0.4709

Step 3. Calculate stress and resistance.

fcd = χ fy / γm0fcd = 0.4709 × 250 / 1.10fcd ≈ 107.03 N/mm²Pd = A fcdPd = 1200 × 107.03 / 1000

Final answer:

Design compressive strength ≈ 128.43 kN under the stated assumptions; connection and other code checks remain.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: યોગ્ય centrally loaded non-slender strut માટે governing KL/r = 100, A = 1200 mm², fy = 250 MPa, E = 200000 MPa, γm0 = 1.10 અને buckling class c (α = 0.49) ધારો. Design strength શોધો. આ one-leg-connected angle ની ગણતરી નથી.

Step 1. Nondimensional slenderness ગણો.

λ̄ = (KL / r) √(fy / (π²E))λ̄ = 100 √(250 / (π² × 200000))λ̄ ≈ 1.1254

Step 2. Buckling parameters ગણો.

φ = 0.5[1 + α(λ̄ − 0.2) + λ̄²]φ = 0.5[1 + 0.49(1.1254 − 0.2) + 1.1254²]φ ≈ 1.3600χ = 1 / [φ + √(φ² − λ̄²)]χ ≈ 0.4709

Step 3. Stress અને resistance ગણો.

fcd = χ fy / γm0fcd = 0.4709 × 250 / 1.10fcd ≈ 107.03 N/mm²Pd = A fcdPd = 1200 × 107.03 / 1000

અંતિમ જવાબ:

આપેલ assumptions હેઠળ design compressive strength ≈ 128.43 kN; connection અને અન્ય code checks બાકી છે.

q.en: Does one-leg angle always use ordinary KL/r?
q.gu: One-leg angle હંમેશા સામાન્ય KL/r વાપરે છે?

a.en: No; special equivalent slenderness may apply.
a.gu: નહીં; special equivalent slenderness લાગુ પડી શકે.

q.gu: Section elements ને classify કેમ કરાય?

a.en: To account for local buckling susceptibility.
a.gu: Local buckling ની શક્યતા ધ્યાનમાં લેવા.

q.gu: Double angles ને સાથે કેમ જોડાય?

a.en: To achieve the intended built-up action and restraint.
a.gu: ઇચ્છિત built-up action અને restraint મેળવવા.
